pois.name: Marine Building
pois.description: McCarter & Nairne's 1930 Art Deco tower (98m), decorated with sea creatures, ships and the zodiac in terracotta. Called 'the greatest office building in the British Empire' at its opening.

pois.name: Canada Place
pois.description: Eberhard Zeidler's 1986 complex with five white teflon sails evoking a sailing ship on Coal Harbour. The Canada Trade Centre and Alaska/BC cruise ship terminal.

pois.name: Christ Church Cathedral
pois.description: Vancouver's oldest church (1895), a Gothic sandstone building dwarfed by surrounding towers. The contrast between its hand-hewn stone and the glass office blocks beside it is iconic.

pois.name: Gastown Steam Clock
pois.description: Raymond Saunders' 1977 steam-powered clock whistles every 15 minutes. In historic Gastown — Vancouver's first neighbourhood, cobblestoned and reinvented as its best restaurant strip.
